title: One Fish Sold for $3.1 Million. It Weighed 612 Pounds

scenes.text: One fish sold for three million dollars.
It was a 612 pound bluefin tuna, sold in Tokyo in 2019.
A sushi restaurant owner bid 333 million yen, double the old record.
And the fish is a beast. It's warm-blooded, which is rare for fish.
It swims up to 43 miles an hour, as fast as a car in town.
So that's what a three million dollar fish looks like.

description:
A single 612 pound bluefin tuna sold for about 3.1 million dollars at a Tokyo auction in 2019.
The fish is warm-blooded and can swim up to 43 miles an hour.
Would you pay that much for a fish?
first_comment: Would you pay millions for a fish, or is that crazy?
